hints.title: Scan in stages
hints.body: Skip spaces, read the sign, then consume digits. Stop as soon as a character is not a digit.

hints.title: No digits
hints.body: If the digit run is empty, the answer is zero.

hints.title: Clamp early
hints.body: Check whether the next digit would exceed the 32-bit limit before adding it.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
i = 0
skip spaces
sign = 1
if text[i] is '+' or '-': set sign and advance
value = 0
while text[i] is a digit:
    digit = numeric value
    if value > (limit - digit) // 10: return clamp
    value = value * 10 + digit
    i += 1
return sign * value
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
